name: nextcloud/snapcloud
description: <![CDATA[The snapcloud app brings professional-grade version control workflows—specifically Git's core functionality into the native Nextcloud file manager experience. Users can treat their shared cloud storage not just as a file repository, but as a tracked, auditable source of truth. Key features include right-click context menu actions for staging and committing local changes, retrieving historical snapshots (rollbacks), and maintaining version integrity with minimal effort. This minimizes the need to switch contexts to a dedicated Git client while providing critical safety nets for document collaboration.]]>
